_comment: A hand-built dataset with a KNOWN answer for every metric. compute_test.go
asserts each of those answers by hand-computed constant, so a change to a
computation shows up as a specific wrong number and not as a diff.
Measured with -now 2026-06-15T00:00:00Z and -window-days 14, so the window
is 2026-06-01..2026-06-15. Everything below is dated relative to that.
It is also the worked example of the input format: this is exactly what

pull_requests._comment: PR1 — merged on the FIRST implementation pass: a review, then nothing.
pull_requests.title: first pass
pull_requests.author: app

pull_requests._comment: PR2 — one rework cycle, and a CHANGES_REQUESTED review.
pull_requests.title: one round trip
pull_requests.author: app

pull_requests._comment: PR3 — two rework cycles, the second answered by a FORCE PUSH rather than a new commit.
pull_requests.title: two round trips
pull_requests.author: app

pull_requests._comment: PR4 — merged with NO review at all. Excluded from the first-pass rate; never counted as a first pass.
pull_requests.title: unreviewed
pull_requests.author: app

pull_requests._comment: PR5 — open, non-draft, nothing has reviewed it since its last change. 48h waiting at -now.
pull_requests.title: waiting
pull_requests.author: app

pull_requests._comment: PR6 — open DRAFT. Ages, but is not waiting on anybody.
pull_requests.title: draft
pull_requests.author: app

pull_requests._comment: PR7 — open, and its most recent change has already been reviewed. Ages, contributes NOTHING to the awaiting-review median (not a zero).
pull_requests.title: reviewed and current
pull_requests.author: app

pull_requests._comment: PR8 — review happens in THREADS, not whole reviews. T1 resolved with a later commit; T2 resolved with none after it; T3 never resolved.
pull_requests.title: threaded review
pull_requests.author: app

issues._comment: I1 — open since long before the window, no pull request. 45 days old at -now, so aged.
issues.title: old and unstarted

issues._comment: I3 — open, but a pull request exists, so it is NOT counted as unstarted. PR3 came 24h after it.
issues.title: started

issues._comment: I4 — a labelled defect, closed. PR1 came 12h after it. Class proj:media.
issues.title: defect one

issues._comment: I5 — a second defect in the SAME class as I4. Together they are one repeat class.
issues.title: defect two, same class

issues._comment: I6 — a defect with no class label. Excluded from the repeat count rather than bucketed with the other unlabelled ones.
issues.title: defect three, unclassified
